g.text: Postgres 18, as of migration 20261121220000. Everything up to 2026-11-21 is one migration (20261121120000); a database made before it is reset (docker compose down -v), not migrated. PK = primary key, FK = foreign key.

Source of truth: db/migrations/*.sql (db/schema.sql is generated). All times are timestamptz (stored as instants); the database and every app session use TimeZone = UTC. Gold datasets are files in data/gold/, not tables.
